description: This file defines the PlatformCapsData class, which provides methods to retrieve platform capabilities, device information, and perform RPC calls via JSON-RPC. It includes internal classes for JSON-RPC communication and manages external dependencies related to plugin interfaces.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Main class providing platform capability information and RPC communication functionalities.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Inner class managing JSON-RPC communication, including client creation and invocation.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Handles individual JSON-RPC direct link communication, including message creation, sending, and response handling.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Adds dash exclusion list to the provided hash map.

methods.name: GetBrowser
methods.description: Returns browser information as a tuple.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Determines if PCM can be mixed with surround sound.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Checks if firmware updates are disabled.

methods.name: DeviceCapsFeatures
methods.description: Returns device capabilities features as a map.

methods.name: XCALSessionTokenAvailable
methods.description: Checks if XCAL session token is available.
